svg.desc: The training loop: a batch goes through a forward pass, a loss, a backward pass and a weight update, then the loop repeats with the next batch. Gradient clipping and the learning-rate schedule modify the update step. The loop reports four numbers: train loss, validation loss, learning rate and gradient norm.

svg.text: Every trainer you will ever use is this loop with more bookkeeping.
